content: Python is an excellent language for backend web development and building server side APIs.
Python with NumPy and PyTorch powers most machine learning and deep learning research today.
Rust provides memory safety guarantees for systems programming without a garbage collector.
PostgreSQL is a robust relational database supporting advanced SQL queries, joins, and transactions.
Redis is an in-memory key value store commonly used for caching, rate limiting, and pub sub.
Docker packages applications and their dependencies into containers for reproducible deployment.
Kubernetes orchestrates containerized workloads and services across a cluster of machines.
Vector databases enable semantic similarity search over high dimensional embeddings.
Retrieval augmented generation grounds large language models with retrieved source documents.
The transformer architecture uses self attention to model dependencies across an input sequence.
Git is a distributed version control system for tracking changes in source code over time.
Pytest is a popular Python testing framework featuring fixtures, parametrization, and plugins.
FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs quickly using type hints.
NumPy provides efficient multi dimensional arrays for numerical computing in Python.
LLM agents combine tools and memory to autonomously accomplish multi step tasks.
